newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain ministry, electricals agree rate cuts - paper.
newsitem.headline: Spain ministry, electricals agree rate cuts - paper.

text.p: The Spanish ministry of industry and electrical companies agreed to reduce tariffs by eight percent in the next five years, according to a report published on Tuesday in the financial daily Expansion.
No one at the ministry was unavailable for immediate comment.
The Expansion said the three percent decline in 1997 would be followed by a two percent cut in 1998 and a reduction of one percent in each of the subsequent three years.

Under this agreement, which forms part of talks on the sector's new regulatory framework, small and medium-sized businesses will benefit the most from the cuts, and in 2001 rates will have declined by up to 20 percent.
Next year, the tariff for small and medium businesses will be reduced by five percent, that of the small consumer by one percent and rates for large business will stay the same.
